_doc: #881 THE DECLARATION the decisions-use guard (1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-decisions-use-guard.py) reads. Everything it knows about where the fleet's decision-model plumbing lives is here, nothing is named in the script. D1 the wire carries no credential; D2 every declared use validates; D3 every DecisionsLink.decide/outcome call site names a declared use with a string literal, from an app that use lists; D4 a use with a call site names the test that proves its fallback (the app's own path runs when there is no verdict); D5 no app or lib outside key_readers reads the OpenRouter key (the ratchet: a new reader fails, a reader that stops can be removed from the list); D6 the declaration is not vacuous.
_doc_key_readers: The code that may call revealAiKey( today. text-tools DEFINES it; account serves it; keyboard serves it; the image engine and the decisions engine read the token in their own process; calc, search, browser and writer are the apps that predate the engine and still hold the key (waves #882-#884 move them to DecisionsLink one by one, and each one that moves is deleted from this list: the list can only shrink). Mail is deliberately not here: it may choose a model and may never hold, read, store or send the key that pays for it (ac_cloud-mail/test/test-mail-text-tools.sh K1).
